Thank you for your update on the shower repair at Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road, Bellmere, ZZ9 7ZZ (ref R/PM034-1). Your email says an invoice is attached, but no attachment is visible on our system.

Please could you resend the invoice quoting reference R/PM034-1, and confirm in a line whether the cold supply to the shower is now flowing (the tenant's original report was that no water came from the cold side), or whether any further work is needed.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings – Maintenance

input.subject: Shower repair – Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road (Ref R/PM034-1)
input.body:
Dear Ava,

Meadow Works have let us know that their engineer attended and cleaned and greased the shower at Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road (ref R/PM034-1), and they believe this has fixed the main problem.

Could you reply to confirm whether the cold side is now working and you can mix the water to a comfortable temperature? If it is still not right, please tell us what is happening and we will arrange a follow-up. We will check back with you on 4 June if we haven't heard from you.

In the meantime, if the water is still running too hot, please test the temperature before stepping in.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings – Maintenance
